text:
3. 5. 2

Samudayasuttaṃ

1220. Sāvatthiyaṃ:

Catunnaṃ bhikkhave, satipaṭṭhānānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca desissāmi. Taṃ suṇātha. Ko ca bhikkhave, kāyassa samudayo. Āhārasamudayā kāyassa samudayo, āhāranirodhā kāyassa atthagamo. Phassasamudayā vedanānaṃ samudayo. 2 Phassanirodhā vedanānaṃ atthagamo. Nāmarūpasamudayā cittassa samudayo. Nāmarūpanirodhā cittassa atthagamo. Manasikārasamudayā dhammānaṃ samudayo. Manasikāranirodhā dhammānaṃ atthagamoti.
